# Fact sheet

One row per claim. The script refers to the id. Tags follow the research notes: [V] opened and read on the check date, [S] single or secondary source, [C] sources conflict (give every version), [GAP] not found.

| Id | Claim, one sentence | Kind (history / game) | Source and URL | Checked | Tag | Checked by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| F1 | | | | | | |
| F2 | | | | | | |

## Rules

- A row tagged [S], [C] or [GAP] does not go in a script as a plain fact. Qualify it or leave it out.
- A game claim cites the commit id of the recorded build, or the README or GDD line, and says whether the feature is in the build or in development.
- A quote has its own sheet (`quote-source-sheet.md`) and an id Q1, Q2 and so on.
